data.one_liner: Query device for installed email apps and open them or present a picker.
data.what_it_does: Provides the ability to query a device for installed email applications and open them. On iOS where multiple mail apps might be installed, it allows showing a picker dialog since there is no native default app intent system.
use_when: You need to let users choose which installed email app to open on iOS or Android.
url_launcher's default behavior of only opening the default mail app is insufficient.
avoid_when: You only need to compose a standard email or open a mailto link using the system default app.
You are not willing to configure iOS Info.plist application queries schemes.
strengths: Allows querying available email apps on the device.
Provides a built-in mail app picker dialog helper.
Solves iOS limitation regarding non-default email apps.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of URL schemes in iOS Info.plist.
New email apps must be added to both the app's Info.plist and the library source.
data.setup_notes: iOS requires you to list the URL schemes you would like to query in the Info.plist file under LSApplicationQueriesSchemes.

alternatives.name: url_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you just want to compose an email or open any app with a mailto link without querying or picking specific installed clients.
